title: Ambiguity Changes the Model
summary: Use an operational event log with sources, events, and incidents to practice Phase 0 paper modeling before SQL.
learning_objectives: Identify entities, attributes, and relationships from prose requirements.
Separate duplicated facts from legitimate repeated values.
Name invariants and lifecycle events without using SQL syntax.
reflection_prompts: Which fact in this model would be most dangerous to copy into two places?
Which lifecycle event would a reviewer need before trusting the current state?

references.why: Explains why PostgreSQL Foundations starts from business reality before database syntax.
